item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 17/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Showers and thunderstorms associated with a trough of low pressure will still affect the coast of Guangdong today. With the trough of low pressure weakening gradually and an anticyclone aloft strengthening, showers will lessen and the weather will improve over southern China early to midweek this week. A weak northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coast of southeastern China in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 17/09 (Sunday)
Wind: East to southeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Sunny intervals and a few showers. Showers will be heavier at times in some areas with isolated thunderstorms during the day.
Temp range: 26 - 31 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium High
